diagnostico_una_linea: Three review apps are loading at once, and your store takes 5.2s to show a product on mobile.

supuestos: Target LCP of 2.5s, the Core Web Vitals "good" threshold.
Coefficient of 8% of conversion per second above target.
Monthly revenue unknown, so the figure stays a percentage.
coste_estimado_mensual.fuente: 0.8% of conversion per extra 100ms — pending verification against the primary source

hallazgos.titulo: Three review apps are running side by side
hallazgos.que_pasa: Judge.me, Loox and Yotpo are all loading on the same page. Each one ships its own widget, its own stylesheet and its own copy of the review data.
hallazgos.por_que_cuesta_dinero: Together they block the main thread for 1570 ms. That is a second and a half where a tap on your product page does nothing, on the page where people decide to buy.
hallazgos.que_haria: Keep Judge.me, export the reviews out of Loox and Yotpo, import them, and uninstall both apps. One widget, all the reviews.

hallazgos.titulo: Your competitor shows a product in 1.8s. You take 5.2s.
hallazgos.que_pasa: Same test, same day, same connection. By the time your first product image appears, a shopper on competidor-uno.com has already scrolled past three.
hallazgos.por_que_cuesta_dinero: Every visitor who hesitates during those seconds is a visitor they keep and you do not. On mobile, most of them never come back.
hallazgos.que_haria: Fix the review apps and the hero image first. Those two alone close most of the gap.

hallazgos.titulo: The hero image is sent at 2400px to a 390px phone
hallazgos.que_pasa: Your homepage hero is served at full desktop resolution to every device. A phone downloads the whole thing and then throws away most of the pixels.
hallazgos.por_que_cuesta_dinero: It is the single heaviest thing on the page and it sits in front of everything else. Nothing your customer came for appears until it lands.
hallazgos.que_haria: Serve a responsive srcset from Shopify's image CDN and convert the hero to WebP. The theme already supports it.

hallazgos.titulo: Nine font files, none with font-display
hallazgos.que_pasa: Three families across nine weights, and not one declares font-display. The browser hides your text until the fonts arrive.
hallazgos.por_que_cuesta_dinero: Your product names and prices are invisible for the first seconds. The page looks broken rather than slow, which is worse.
hallazgos.que_haria: Add font-display: swap to every face and drop Playfair Display, which is used on one heading.

hallazgos.titulo: It has been getting worse, not staying still
hallazgos.que_pasa: Real users saw an LCP of 4100 ms six months ago. Today they see 4800 ms. Layout shift went from 0.22 to 0.29 over the same period.
hallazgos.por_que_cuesta_dinero: Whatever has been added since February is still being added. Without a guardrail, the next app install costs you the same again.

evidencia.metrica: CrUX 75th percentile LCP, real users, 6-month trend

hallazgos.que_haria: Put a budget check on the theme so a new app cannot ship without someone seeing what it costs.

tareas: Migrate reviews to a single app and uninstall the other two
Rebuild the image pipeline with responsive srcset and WebP
Add font-display and drop the unused family
plan_3_semanas.resultado_esperado: Mobile LCP under 3s and about 2 MB less on every page load.

plan_3_semanas.objetivo: Get the critical path out of the way
tareas: Defer the remaining third-party scripts behind first interaction
Inline the critical CSS and load the rest asynchronously
Remove the chained redirect in front of the homepage
plan_3_semanas.resultado_esperado: Blocking time under 300 ms and a PageSpeed score in the 70s.

tareas: Set explicit dimensions on every image to settle the layout shift
Add a performance budget check to the theme
Measure again together and write down the numbers
plan_3_semanas.resultado_esperado: CLS under 0.1, mobile score above 85, and a baseline you can hold the next change against.

quick_win_regalado.titulo: Uninstall two of your three review apps
pasos: Open Apps in your Shopify admin and find Loox and Yotpo.
Export the reviews from both to CSV before touching anything.
Import both CSVs into Judge.me, which accepts them directly.
Check a product page still shows every review, then uninstall Loox and Yotpo.
Run PageSpeed Insights on the same product page and compare.
quick_win_regalado.mejora_estimada: About 1200 ms less blocking on mobile

que_pasa_si_no_se_arregla: Nothing dramatic happens on any single day, which is exactly why this sits unfixed for years. Real-user LCP has drifted from 4100 ms to 4800 ms in six months without anyone deciding to make the site slower. Each new app costs a little more, and the gap with competidor-uno.com widens quietly on the page where people decide whether to buy.
datos_faltantes: Monthly revenue unknown, so the cost is expressed as a percentage rather than an amount.
